hhe.text:
// Two parallel lists, indexed the same way as visited:
// visited //dontsave//    — room names in order visited
// parent door //dontsave// — door index used to reach that room (0 for start)

delete all of [visited //dontsave//]
delete all of [parent door //dontsave//]
delete all of [path //dontsave//]
delete all of [bfs]

add [my room] to [visited //dontsave//]
add [0] to [parent door //dontsave//]
enqueue [my room] to [bfs]

repeat until (bfs is empty?):
  set [current] = front of [bfs]
  dequeue from [bfs]

  set [i] = 1
  repeat len(Door from's):
    if (Door from's[i] = current):
      set [neighbor] = Door to's[i]
      if NOT (visited contains neighbor):
        if NOT (forbidden room? neighbor):
          add neighbor to [visited //dontsave//]
          add i to [parent door //dontsave//]   ← record which door reached this room
          enqueue neighbor to [bfs]
    change [i] by 1

// BFS complete — now reconstruct path from target back to my room
set [current room] = target room
repeat until (current room = my room):
  set [r] = item # of [current room] in [visited //dontsave//]
  set [door i] = parent door //dontsave//[r]
  insert [door i] at 1 of [path //dontsave//]   ← build path in reverse
  set [current room] = Door from's[door i]// Two parallel lists, indexed the same way as visited:
